write.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Outlook)
write.best: Firms already on Microsoft 365 that want AI drafting and thread summaries inside Outlook, Word and Teams
write.price: Copilot Chat free with M365 business plans; Copilot Business add-on US$18/user/mo annual (promo to Dec 31 2026, list $21); 1-month trial (card required)
notes: Free Copilot Chat tier; paid add-on 1-mo trial
No training; M365 data at rest in Canada; local inference 2027
write.rc: Free Copilot Chat covers basic drafting, but the in-Outlook mailbox-aware features need the paid add-on per seat, and the $18 promo price ends after year one.
write.canada: Canadian M365 tenants keep data at rest in Canadian datacentres; in-country Copilot inference for Canada slipped to 2027. Full Canadian French; CAD billing via Microsoft/CSP partners.

write.name: Gemini in Gmail (Google Workspace)
write.best: Google Workspace shops that want Help me write, thread summaries and Gems inside Gmail and Docs
write.price: Included in Workspace Business Starter US$7/user/mo (Standard $14, Plus $22); 14-day trial
notes: Included at no extra cost in all Workspace plans
No training; admin retention 90d+; no Canada region
Help me write matches your tone
write.rc: Cheapest route if you already pay for Workspace, but Gemini only sees Google data; data regions are EU/US only and only on Enterprise-tier editions.
write.canada: No Canadian data region for Gemini; good Canadian French. CAD billing available on Workspace.

write.name: Grammarly
write.best: Mixed-app teams that want consistent tone and brand style everywhere staff type (Outlook, Gmail, Word, Docs)
write.price: Free plan; Pro US$12/member/mo (annual); Enterprise custom
notes: Self-serve Pro teams: training ON by default (admin opt-out)
Roles and user groups; SSO Enterprise only
write.rc: Self-serve Pro team accounts are opted IN to AI training by default, so an admin must switch it off; French support is newer and lighter than English.
write.canada: French grammar support added 2025 (English-only interface). Data hosted in the US; no Canadian region.

write.name: ChatGPT Business (OpenAI)
write.best: General-purpose drafting, rewriting and research for staff who will copy results into email and documents
write.price: Free plan; Business US$20/user/mo annual or $25 monthly (2-seat min)
notes: Business not trained on; Canada residency Enterprise-only
write.rc: Staff love it, but the free tier trains on prompts, so move work use to Business seats; it lives outside the inbox, which means copy-paste.
write.canada: Canadian data residency exists but only for Enterprise/Edu; Business data is US-hosted. Strong French.

write.name: Claude Team (Anthropic)
write.best: Long, careful writing (proposals, policies, client letters) with shared projects and an Outlook add-in
write.price: Free plan; Team US$20/seat/mo annual or $25 monthly (2-150 seats)
notes: Claude for Microsoft 365/Outlook plus Google connectors
No training by default on Team; no Canada region
write.rc: Excellent writer, but usage limits per seat can bite heavy users (Premium seats are $100+); the Gmail side is a connector, not an in-inbox add-in.
write.canada: No Canadian data residency for Team; good French output and interface.

write.name: MailMaestro
write.best: Low-cost AI email assistant that drafts and summarises inside both Outlook and Gmail
write.price: Free plan; paid US$12/seat/mo (20% off annual); 14-day trial, no card
notes: States data never used for training; SOC 2
write.rc: Inexpensive and simple, but it is a small UK vendor; SSO and enterprise controls start at 100 seats.
write.canada: Data location not published; check DPA if handling Quebec Law 25 personal data.

meet.name: Fellow
meet.best: Canadian-built AI notetaker plus meeting agendas and action items, with strong privacy defaults
meet.price: Free plan; Team US$7/user/mo annual ($11 monthly); Business $15 annual
notes: Never trains on customer content; custom retention 'coming soon'
Zoom, Teams, Meet on all plans
Ask Fellow AI chat across meetings
meet.rc: Cheapest entry price, but CRM push needs Business ($15) and transcript redaction/user provisioning are Enterprise-only.
meet.canada: Ottawa-based Canadian vendor; data hosted on AWS (region not published), confirm for Law 25.

meet.name: Otter.ai
meet.best: Simple, well-known transcription and meeting summaries for small teams on any platform
meet.price: Free plan (300 min/mo); Pro US$8.33/user/mo annual; Business $19.99 annual ($30 monthly)
notes: Trains on de-identified data; opt-out Enterprise
meet.rc: Otter trains on de-identified recordings by default and faced a 2025 class action over consent; set auto-join carefully and tell participants.
meet.canada: US-hosted; French transcription available but no French interface.

meet.name: Fireflies.ai
meet.best: Searchable meeting library with many CRM and task integrations at a low per-seat price
meet.price: Free plan; Pro US$10/seat/mo annual ($18 monthly); Business $19 annual ($29 monthly)
notes: 100+ languages; French site, app UI unclear
No training on meeting data; custom retention Enterprise
meet.rc: AI credits are limited even on paid tiers, and custom retention and SSO need Enterprise ($39).
meet.canada: No published Canadian data region (private storage on Enterprise). Multilingual mode on Business.

meet.name: Fathom
meet.best: Generous free notetaker for client-facing staff, with HubSpot/Salesforce sync on paid tiers
meet.price: Free plan (unlimited recordings); Premium US$16/user/mo annual; Team $15 annual (2-user min); Business $25
notes: De-identified data trains own models; opt-out
meet.rc: The free plan is genuinely useful, but CRM field sync needs Business ($25) and training must be switched off by an admin.
meet.canada: All data stored in the United States.

meet.name: Read AI
meet.best: Meeting reports plus search across meetings, email and chat, with a Canadian hosting option
meet.price: Free plan (5 meetings/mo); Pro US$15/user/mo annual ($19.75 monthly); Enterprise+ $29.75 annual
notes: EU/CA hosting and custom retention on Enterprise+
Ask Read across meetings and email
meet.rc: Canada hosting, SSO and custom retention all sit on the top Enterprise+ tier (5+ licences); free tier caps at 5 meetings.
meet.canada: One of few notetakers offering Canadian (CA) data hosting, on Enterprise+.

meet.name: Notion AI Meeting Notes
meet.best: Teams that run projects and docs in Notion and want meeting notes and tasks in the same place
meet.price: Business US$20/member/mo (AI Meeting Notes included); Free/Plus include a limited AI trial
notes: AI trial only; meeting notes need Business
No training unless you opt in; zero retention on Enterprise
Desktop capture works on any call
Turns action items into Notion tasks
meet.rc: Best only if the team already lives in Notion; pushing tasks to outside CRMs needs connectors, and $20/member adds up.
meet.canada: French interface available; no Canadian data region (EU/US options on Enterprise).

sales.name: HubSpot (Breeze AI)
sales.best: All-in-one CRM, email marketing and sales tools that grow with a small team
sales.price: Free CRM (2 users); Starter from US$20/seat/mo ($7 promo); Sales Hub Professional from $100/seat/mo
notes: AI training ON by default (admin opt-out); Canada DC
Is a CRM; native Salesforce sync
sales.rc: Starter is cheap, but sequences and serious automation need Professional (~$100/seat), a big jump; switch off AI training in settings.
sales.canada: HubSpot runs a Canadian data centre (new paid accounts assigned by location; migration free). Full French. Billed in USD.

sales.name: Apollo.io
sales.best: Finding B2B prospects and running cold email sequences from one tool
sales.price: Free plan; Basic US$49/user/mo annual ($65 monthly); Professional $79 annual
notes: Internal models may train on customer data
sales.rc: Contact data and cold email must respect CASL (express or implied consent) — Apollo's database does not make outreach compliant; credits run out fast.
sales.canada: US-hosted on Google Cloud; check CASL before emailing Canadian prospects.

sales.name: Mailchimp
sales.best: Easy newsletters and automated email journeys for small retailers and service firms
sales.price: Free plan (250 contacts); Essentials from US$13/mo; Standard from $20/mo; 14-day trial
notes: French UI; AI writer English-only beta
Training use not stated; US data centres
sales.rc: Price climbs quickly with contact count, and the AI writer is English-only beta, so French campaigns are written by hand.
sales.canada: Data in US data centres; French interface; CAD shown in currency selector.

sales.name: ActiveCampaign
sales.best: Small teams wanting powerful email automation and a light CRM at mid-range cost
sales.price: No free plan; Starter US$15/mo annual (1,000 contacts, $19 monthly); Plus $49 annual; 14-day trial, no card
notes: Does not train on your data
sales.rc: Generative AI and CRM start on Plus ($49), and native Salesforce sync is Enterprise-only.
sales.canada: French interface; data hosting region not published (US by default).

sales.name: Klaviyo
sales.best: Shopify and e-commerce stores running email, SMS and reviews from purchase data
sales.price: Free plan (250 profiles); Email from US$20/mo (500 profiles); Marketing $25/mo
notes: Trains own models on de-identified data
sales.rc: Great with Shopify, but cost rises per active profile and SMS is an add-on; weaker fit for B2B service firms.
sales.canada: Works natively with Shopify (Canadian); CASL consent tools needed for SMS/email.

sales.name: Hootsuite
sales.best: Scheduling, writing and reporting on social posts across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and more
notes: AI terms let Hootsuite train on content
sales.rc: Per-user price is high for a 1–2 person marketing team, and its AI terms allow training on your content with no opt-out.
sales.canada: Vancouver-based Canadian vendor; French interface. Billed in USD.
